author: reactive-end
summary: `.harness/qa/flows/*.json` scripted browser flows (goto/fill/click/expect text/expect request method+url+status/screenshot) run through Playwright with captured network, console and page errors; `anvil qa baseline` + pixel diff; Tier 2 runs flows when UI changed and the app is reachable; `qa select-web chrome_dev_tools` registers a pinned, privacy-safe chrome-devtools-mcp in every adapter's MCP config and grants it to executors.
